summary: Volaris (Controladora Vuela, NYSE: VLRS; BMV: VOLAR) filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its October 2026 preliminary traffic results via press release Exhibit 99.1. ASM capacity rose 7.7% year-over-year to 3,125 million, with international ASMs up 27.5% as the carrier launched five new Guadalajara-U.S. routes; consolidated load factor fell 3.5 points to 82.4% on new capacity ramp. No transaction, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated. Not a special situation; watch unit revenue and load-factor recovery as international capacity matures.
